fusions.name: Spoken Edge
fusions.desc: Speaks a blade of force at the first enemy within 7 tiles, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Recited Kata
fusions.desc: Runs a full kata around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Form
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Grammar of Steel
fusions.desc: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
